meta.name: laravel-specialist
meta.description: Build and configure Laravel 10+ applications, including creating Eloquent models and relationships, implementing Sanctum authentication, configuring Horizon queues, designing RESTful APIs with API resources, and building reactive interfaces with Livewire. Use when creating Laravel models, setting up queue workers, implementing Sanctum auth flows, building Livewire components, optimising Eloquent queries, or writing Pest/PHPUnit tests for Laravel features.

copy.tagline: 构建和配置 Laravel 应用，包括模型、认证、队列和 API
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Laravel 框架开发 Web 应用
copy.tagline_en: Build and configure Laravel applications with models, auth, queues, and APIs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing web applications with Laravel framework

howto.what: Claude 会以 Laravel 专家身份，按分析→设计→实现→构建→测试的流程，产出 Eloquent 模型、API 资源、队列任务、Livewire 组件及测试代码，并遵循 PHP 8.2+ 和 PSR-12 规范。
howto.when: 当你说到 'Laravel'、'Eloquent'、'Sanctum' 等关键词，或要求创建模型、设置队列、编写测试等 Laravel 相关任务时触发。

say.text: 创建 User 模型，关联 Post 一对多。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Eloquent 模型和迁移。

say.text: 配置 Horizon 队列，让发送邮件任务异步执行。
say.note: Claude 会创建队列任务并配置 Horizon。

say.text: 为这个 API 写一个 Pest 测试并运行。
say.note: Claude 会编写测试并执行。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a Laravel specialist, following an analyze-design-implement-build-test workflow, producing Eloquent models, API resources, queue jobs, Livewire components, and tests, while adhering to PHP 8.2+ and PSR-12 standards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'Laravel', 'Eloquent', 'Sanctum', or ask to create models, set up queues, write tests, or similar Laravel tasks.

say_en.text: Create a User model with a one-to-many relationship to Post.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the Eloquent model and migration.

say_en.text: Configure Horizon queues to run email sending jobs asynchronously.
say_en.note: Claude will create the job and Horizon config.

say_en.text: Write a Pest test for this API and run it.
say_en.note: Claude will write the test and execute it.
